name: SqlSyntaxCheck
description: Dialect-aware SQL syntax checking for T-SQL and Snowflake before deployment
helpMarkDown: Checks .sql files for syntax errors using sqlfluff, routed by dialect (T-SQL / Snowflake) via a config file or folder convention.
author: Prajwal

inputs.name: dialectConfigPath
inputs.label: Dialect config file (optional)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to a JSON file mapping glob patterns to dialects. If omitted, all files use the default dialect below.

inputs.name: failOnError
inputs.label: Fail the build on syntax errors
